facts.value: Samples HSD_PAD_B in fp->input.held_buttons[0]; absence sets mv.fx.SpecialLw.isRelease, which is not cleared here. Not holding B latches isRelease; holding or repressing B does not clear it. Positive releaseLag decrements by one. Whenever releaseLag is nonpositive and isRelease is set, the callback enters grounded End for GA_Ground or aerial End otherwise. Holding B prevents this exit only while no prior release has been latched.

facts.value: Passes gobj to ft_80081D0C and invokes ftFx_SpecialAirLwEnd_AirToGround only for a nonzero result; the adapter enters grounded End and clamps drift. The predicate synchronizes collision and fighter positions, returns GA_Ground when ft_80081A00 succeeds, and otherwise returns GA_Air for a true map-collision result or GA_Ground for false. Its enum labels must not be substituted for the caller's literal boolean guard without resolving their numeric meaning.

facts.value: Each tick latches B release and decrements releaseLag only while positive. No continuation occurs while animation frames remain. At exhaustion, the shared check selects End if release is latched and lag is nonpositive, otherwise Loop with reflection collision recreated; either destination is grounded for GA_Ground and aerial otherwise. Only the Loop result triggers effect cleanup and deferred Loop GFX scheduling.

Normal Turn entry already performs one immediate update after initializing turnFrames and clearing the latch. When turnFrames is nonpositive, the shared check selects End for eligible release or recreates Loop otherwise, choosing grounded versus aerial destination from current ground_or_air.

facts.value: Reads Fighter and Fox attributes, decrements turnFrames, then tests cmd_vars[0] and turnFrames <= x9C_FOX_REFLECTOR_TURN_FRAMES. If eligible it sets the latch and negates facing_dir.
